about: Tokens this app adds to APL (approved 2026-11-15). Not part of the APL design system: errors and destructive text, and data colours that are drawn but never mark UI state. Like the design system's tokens, a value is one colour for both themes or a {dark, light} pair.

color.name: danger
color.usage: Error text, destructive text buttons (dark 7.6:1, light 5.6:1 on surface) and the fill of a destructive dialog's confirm button (with on-danger text). Never next to a target face as a score colour.

color.name: on-danger
color.usage: Text on a danger fill (the confirm button of a destructive dialog).

color.name: score-miss
color.usage: Data: a miss (M) on score keys and chips, beside the target-* ring colours.

color.name: data-edge
color.usage: Outline of a score or grade key whose data fill is light (target-gold, target-white, score-miss, grade-2…4). Dark: none (the fill shows); light: the border colour, so the key stays visible on a white surface. The fill itself never changes.

color.name: grade-1
color.usage: Data: grade 1 (best) on M / S keys and badges.

color.name: grade-5
color.usage: Data: grade 5 (worst). Not an error colour.

color.name: on-grade-dark
color.usage: Text on grade-2, grade-3 and grade-4.

color.name: mark
color.usage: Data: an arrow's place on the face, and the arrow being moved or picked on the running session.

color.name: series-1
color.usage: Data: chart series 1 (Insights: training sessions). Validated as a categorical set on surface (3:1 or more in both themes).

color.name: series-2
color.usage: Data: chart series 2 (Insights: competition sessions). Validated as a categorical set on surface.

color.name: series-3
color.usage: Data: chart series 3 (Insights: SPT sessions). Validated as a categorical set on surface.

color.name: series-4
color.usage: Data: chart series 4 (Insights: mental sessions). Validated as a categorical set on surface.

color.name: series-5
color.usage: Data: chart series 5 (Insights: blank bale sessions). Validated as a categorical set on surface.

color.name: series-6
color.usage: Data: chart series 6 (Insights: manual sessions). Validated as a categorical set on surface.
